title: UN Commission finding on gender-based violence policy in detention
summary: The Commission assessed widespread sexual and gender-based violence against Palestinian detainees across multiple facilities and stages of custody.
claim: The Commission found that mistreatment of Palestinian detainees by Israeli authorities resulted from an intentional policy using sexual, reproductive and other forms of gender-based violence to humiliate and degrade Palestinians in detention.
legal_characterization: Policy finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment or assignment of individual criminal responsibility.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: “More than a human can bear”: Israel’s systematic use of sexual, reproductive and other forms of gender-based violence since 7 October 2023
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 222 of A/HRC/58/CRP.6. The record is limited to the Commission's finding about an intentional detention policy and does not assign criminal responsibility to a named individual.
